description: Search public Substack people, recent notes, posts, publications, or the mixed Top view by query. Uses the verified browser API first, applies light randomized browser pacing, and falls back to visible search-page DOM results when the API is unavailable or drifts.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum results to return, from 1 to 100

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Search view: top, recent, posts, publications, or people

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort order; Substack search does not support sorting, so non-default values are reported in ignoredParams

parameters.name: time
parameters.description: Time range; Substack search does not support time filtering, so non-all values are reported in ignoredParams
